history.summary: A 700 sqft freehold 2BR in D15 (Eunos/Geylang fringe) at $1571 PSF / $1.1M, 640m from Eunos MRT. The asking is ~18% ABOVE the thin $1327 URA median, but that median rests on only 3 transactions, so the comparison is unreliable.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold 2BR in D15 at a deep-liquidity sub-$1.1M quantum with a workable 700 sqft layout is structurally attractive. But the only value anchor — a $1327 median on just 3 txns — is too thin to trust, and at face value the asking sits ~18% above it. No reliable appreciation series exists. The sound quantum/format and freehold tenure balance against the unverifiable value picture — Neutral pending current comparable transactions.
